cases.name: merge
cases.with_skill_prompt: Use the gitea-merge skill at {skill_dir}/SKILL.md. Merge {pr_url} with rebase using repository {repo_dir} and Tea home {tea_home}. Run the skill script as the first operational command, do not inspect files or run tests, and report the result plus the number of tool calls.
cases.without_skill_prompt: Do not load or read any skill. Merge {pr_url} with rebase using repository {repo_dir} and Tea home {tea_home}. Before merging, verify that it targets main, has no conflict, its combined commit status is successful, and it has no outstanding request-changes review. Do not inspect files or run tests. Report the result plus the number of tool calls.
cases.success: The PR is merged by rebase and the merge commit SHA is non-empty.

cases.name: review
cases.with_skill_prompt: Use the gitea-review skill at {skill_dir}/SKILL.md. Review {pr_url} using Tea home {tea_home}; ensure any review worker receives that Tea home. If there is no blocking defect, submit a formal multiline approval. Do not clone or run tests. Report the reviewed head, final review state, and total tool calls including any worker.
cases.without_skill_prompt: Do not load or read any skill. Review {pr_url} using Tea home {tea_home}. Inspect the PR metadata and complete diff through tea/Gitea API, then submit a formal multiline approval if there is no blocking defect. Do not clone or run tests. Report the reviewed head, final review state, and tool calls.
cases.success: The PR remains open and has an APPROVED formal review from the independent reviewer.

cases.name: release
cases.with_skill_prompt: Use the gitea-release skill at {skill_dir}/SKILL.md. Validate {pr_url} as a Release Please publication using repository {repo_dir} and Tea home {tea_home}, but use dry-run and do not merge. Run the skill script as the first operational command and save its unmodified JSON stdout to {repo_dir}/.benchmark-release-validation.json; do not synthesize or overwrite that evidence. Report the validated version and tool calls.
cases.without_skill_prompt: Do not load or read any skill. Validate {pr_url} as a Release Please publication using repository {repo_dir} and Tea home {tea_home}, but do not merge. Verify that it is the only open Release Please PR targeting main, its branch and title identify version 1.2.3, it is open and conflict-free, and the release workflow file exists. Record observed values, without guessing, at {repo_dir}/.benchmark-release-validation.json as {"status":"dry-run","dry_run":true,"version":"1.2.3","workflow":"release.yml","release_pr":{"number":N,"expected_head":"SHA"},"checks":{"only_open_release_pr":true,"release_metadata":true,"workflow_exists":true}}. Report the validated version and tool calls.
cases.success: Version 1.2.3 is validated and the Release Please PR remains unmerged.
